dynamicTools.description: Maintain durable work. start requires title/prompt and completionCriteria; kind work uses an independent background session, coordination uses the current main segment. Finish the foreground turn after dispatch. update/cancel/resume require id/baseVersion. checkpoint/wait/finish require id/baseVersion/baseRevision from status plus a checkpoint. wait records exact discussion question, request, child job or an explicitly requested check time, then end this turn; answers resume the same task automatically without model polling. Retain dependency IDs when an answer is insufficient; only new answers wake it again. Resolve dependencies by citing their actual signalIds and explaining why the condition is met. finish requires outcome/result; completed also requires a criteriaChecks entry for every completion criterion and no unresolved dependency. Tasks from ordinary follow analysis track that goal; direct mentions and independent requests remain independent unless followId is supplied on start. When a bound goal changes, the same worker must call replan with current baseVersion/baseRevision, revised prompt/completionCriteria/checkpoint and retainDependencyIds before further actions; replan preserves selected dependencies and all action history. A native final alone never completes the task. status with id reads complete task state; without id it returns a bounded index; unknown native input must be reconciled, not replayed.

messages.text: 这是专用验证，请直接执行这些工具操作：用 shadow_watch start 关注 discussion task-follow-discussion，goal 为“等待隔离夹具证据，然后核对原目标”，requestId 为 native-follow-start，baseGoalVersion 为 0；再 shadow_task start 创建一个 work 任务，followId 使用返回的认识 ID。任务标题为“Follow lifecycle fixture”，完成条件为“取得原目标所需证据”。任务 prompt 必须原样包含：“先用 shadow_task status 和 checkpoint 保存原目标进展，再调用继承的 shadow_fixture MCP fixture_wait_and_read 等待测试证据。这个调用只读取专用夹具。若目标尚未变化，取得证据后按当前完成条件 finish。若后续收到目标重核指示，优先遵循最新私有 follow goal；不要重复旧的等待调用。” 主轮派发后立即结束，回复 FOLLOW_TASK_STARTED，不等待工作结果，也不代替工作轮调用夹具。
用 shadow_watch read 读取 fc984b0e5a3c9b1d169c5ddd88618b1471d4f620dd909a62666966c25f6b513d，然后 pause 同一目标，requestId=native-follow-pause，使用实际 baseGoalVersion。回复 FOLLOW_TASK_PAUSED。

用 shadow_watch read 读取 fc984b0e5a3c9b1d169c5ddd88618b1471d4f620dd909a62666966c25f6b513d，再 update，requestId=native-follow-update，goal 改为："新目标：核对继承的 MCP 只读 fixture_probe 返回 INHERITED_MCP_MARKER。必须先在原任务中调用 shadow_task replan，以当前 baseVersion/baseRevision 保存新 prompt、完成条件、checkpoint，并传 retainDependencyIds 空数组；保留已做记录。然后调用 fixture_probe，核对标记并 shadow_task finish completed，result 中包含 FOLLOW_REPLAN_DONE。旧的等待证据不再是当前要求。" 保持暂停，回复 FOLLOW_GOAL_UPDATED。
用 shadow_watch read 读取 fc984b0e5a3c9b1d169c5ddd88618b1471d4f620dd909a62666966c25f6b513d，再 resume，requestId=native-follow-resume，使用实际 baseGoalVersion。主轮只恢复关注，原工作会话负责目标重核；回复 FOLLOW_TASK_RESUMED。
